description: Crash-test a chatbot or AI agent with BotArmor: up to 12 attack levels (fake manager, angry customer, fake lawyer, prompt injection, role-play, phishing, AI disclosure under the EU AI Act, invented facts...) plus level 13 for agents with tools, 5 adaptive sessions each. Two modes. target_type 'prompt' (default when no endpoint_url): BotArmor plays the agent's system prompt on its own model; use it for an agent running on localhost or not deployed yet, reading the system prompt from the code. target_type 'openai-compatible' or 'webhook': a live audit of a running bot at a public https URL; requires authorization_confirmed: true, only after the user confirmed they own the bot or have written permission. Returns the audit id; an audit takes 5 to 20 minutes, after which its status and report are available by that id. Uses one audit credit.

authorization_confirmed.description: Live audits only. true = the user confirmed they own the bot or hold the owner's written permission to test it.

body_template.description: webhook only: JSON body with {{input}} (current message), "{{history}}" or "{{messages}}". Default {message: "{{input}}", session_id: "{{session_id}}"}.

endpoint_url.description: Public https URL of the running agent (live audits only). localhost cannot be reached from BotArmor's servers.

headers.description: Headers the target needs, e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer ..."}. A credential header is stored encrypted by BotArmor.

levels.description: Subset of levels; default all 12 (plus 'agency' when tools are declared).

min_grade.description: Pass threshold shown by get_audit_status, default B.

model.description: openai-compatible only: the model name sent in the request body.

response_path.description: webhook only: dot path to the reply text in the response JSON, e.g. data.reply.

system_prompt.description: The agent's system prompt / instructions, as in its code. For a live audit it is also the rulebook the judge checks answers against.

target_type.description: Default: 'webhook' when endpoint_url is given, else 'prompt'.

name: start_audit
title: Start a BotArmor audit
